updates.title: Rolling sumaries, Mermaid rendering, and more!
updates.description: This version improves summaries across the app, adds Mermaid diagram rendering within READMEs, and includes several bug fixes and enhancements. I've also added a new model, Granite 3.1 3B A800M to the list of models available for local inference.
notes: Added support for rendering Mermaid diagrams within README files on Adroid and iOS
Updated summary generation to use rolling summaries for better context retention
Fixed an issue causing the keyboard to cover input fields while chatting with Lab Assistant
Fixed an issue causing LLM settings to show when 'No AI' is selected
Fixed an issue causing corrupted summary text as a result of non-ASCII characters in LLM output

updates.title: PocketLab 2.2.1 - Bug Fixes and Enhancements
updates.description: This version includes minor bug fixes and UX enhancements.
notes: Fixed a bug preventing the default branch from showing on smaller devices
Disabled local LLM configuration on Android devices due to stability issues
Added a toggle to run summaries on demand rather than on page load
Load and categorize Ollama models after connecting to an Ollama server

updates.title: On-device LLM inference is here!
updates.description: Happy New Year! PocketLab now supports on-device LLM inference with several small but powerful models in the Qwen, Gemma, and Phi families. If you're main priority is privacy and offline functionality, head over to the profile screen -> LLM Configuration and switch from Ollama to Local Model. For those who love PocketLab but hate having AI features forced on them, there's now a toggle to disable all AI functionality in the settings page. As always, thank you for any feedback that you're willing to provide, and have a great 2026! This won't be the last time you hear from me this year :)
notes: Added support for on-device LLM inference
Added on-device support for Qwen 2.5 7B, Qwen 3 8B, Phi 4 Mini 4B, and Gemma 3 4B models
Provided the option to configure a routing model (e.g. FunctionGemma) for dynamic tool selection
Tweaked the settings pages for better usability
Added a toggle to switch Lab Assistant on and off
Added an option to totally disable AI functionality
